FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Petal & Bloom Artificial Flowers is a retail business specializing in the sale of high-quality artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations include providing a wide range of floral products for both individual customers and event planners. We focus on offering exceptional customer service and floral design consultations to help our clients create beautiful arrangements. We operate primarily from our brick-and-mortar location, ensuring a controlled shopping environment, and we adhere to all local zoning and fire regulations to maintain safety and compliance. Our inventory is stored in secured, climate-controlled areas to preserve product quality and minimize any risk of spoilage or damage. Additionally, we limit delivery services, ensuring our primary focus remains on in-store sales and consultations. All employees receive safety and operational training to maintain a safe work environment while serving our clients.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to water damage from a leaky roof on 03/05/2023, caused by heavy rainfall. Total cost of repairs was $2,500. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sat 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Climate-controlled safe, Class B, Suitable for securing cash and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured fencing around inventory storage areas and trained watchpersons during non-business hours.
